# YVARS

> Voice qualitative research workspace: adaptive 1:1 voice interviews (French, English, Arabic) linked to competitive intelligence. A workspace for deciding, not a frozen deck.

Canonical: https://yvars.io
Also: https://www.yvars.io (redirects to apex)

## Product

- Adaptive voice interviews (not a text chatbot, not a fixed questionnaire)
- Insights workspace: transcripts, axes, radar, insight chat
- Intelligence Lab: verbatims next to observed shelf prices / gaps / private label
- Clients bring respondents (own base / recruiter); optional paid panel for some briefs
- Not a worldwide recruitment marketplace; not video interviews

## Who it is for

- Research institutes and independents
- Insights / category / innovation teams
- Retail and shopper teams

## Languages

French, English, Arabic (interview language = participant language)

## Pages

- [Home](https://yvars.io/): product, use cases, FAQ, contact / demo
- [Panel](https://yvars.io/panel.html): apply to paid respondent pool
